narrative.overview: ResearchGraph reads like a scientist's bound lab notebook: warm paper, charcoal ink, and serif annotation — not a dark terminal dashboard. The interface treats the working graph as a desk rather than a server room. Light mode is not a default but the product's own surface: the researcher sits in front of a screen reading and supervising, and the paper ground keeps the screen calm across long sessions.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas with white index-card surfaces and hairline borders.
Serif masthead and section headings; sans body; mono for metrics, ratings, and statuses.
Two accents: ink for commit, amber for experiment and attention.
A thin 6px custom scrollbar and a lucide icon system in one stroke weight.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink (#1c1917) commits; amber (#b45309) experiments. The primary action and Approve are always ink; the experiment action and anything awaiting attention are amber. Never swap the two.

rules.name: The Paper-Ground Rule
rules.body: The ground is warm paper; only elevated surfaces (cards, ghost buttons, controls) are white.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Measurement Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the interface shows a value, a state, or a tag — never for a sentence of body copy.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted from charcoal ink (rgba(28,25,23,…)), never neutral black, and always carry both an offset and a soft blur.

dos: Do set the app, top bar, and sidebar on warm paper #f7f5f0, and let only cards and buttons be white.
Do keep measurements, ratings, statuses, roles, and counts in JetBrains Mono.
Do use ink (#1c1917) for commit actions and Approve, amber (#b45309) for experiments and attention states.
Do keep the scrollbar thin (6px) and warm (#d6cfc2), with the track transparent.
donts: Don't revert the canvas to a dark theme — light warm paper is the product's surface, not an option.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; use the lucide icon set at a consistent stroke weight.
Don't apply a one-sided accent bar to a card; use a full border or a background tint for pending states.
Don't use neutral-black or cool-gray shadows; tint them from charcoal ink.
Don't set body copy in monospace — reserve it for measurement and status.
